freeze.freeze: Before cohort outputs; no tuning after results.

concave.objective: Source exact RGB mass to power .75, normalized to original mass

hue.objective: 90% original mass +10% equally weighted occupied Oklab hue groups; 12 sectors + neutral group

freeze.invariant: Auto generation, nearest mapping, alpha and target colors unchanged; full-nearest and empty fast paths unchanged; binned high-entropy path unchanged.

scope: Exact RGB subset selection only. Auto generation, matching, alpha, Cleanup and dithering unchanged.

concave.meaning: Point error is diagnostic, not a semantic or visible-quality judgment.

hue.meaning: Point error is diagnostic, not a semantic or visible-quality judgment.
